title: AI & Automation Engineer
description:
About AbbVie
AbbVie's mission is to discover and deliver innovative medicines and solutions that solve serious health issues today and address the medical challenges of tomorrow. We strive to have a remarkable impact on people's lives across several key therapeutic areas including immunology, oncology, and neuroscience - and products and services in our Allergan Aesthetics portfolio. For more information about AbbVie, please visit us at  www.abbvie.com . Follow @abbvie on  LinkedIn,   Facebook ,  Instagram ,  X  and  YouTube.
The Cyber Security Engineering team is seeking a dynamic AI & Automation Engineer to build and support the critical technologies that enable our Information Security and Incident Response teams. Operating in a highly collaborative, hybrid Agile/Scrum environment, you will leverage Python and Golang to develop robust scripting, orchestrate tasks within Cortex XSOAR, and streamline complex security operations. Beyond traditional SOAR engineering, you will play a pivotal role in our AI enablement journey by exploring, securing, and implementing cutting-edge technologies like Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Agent-to-Agent communications, and the Model Context Protocol (MCP). We are looking for a strong software engineer with a passion for learning emerging AI concepts who can effectively partner with cross-functional teams to automate our defenses and accelerate incident response.
Responsibilities:
Automation Script Development:  Write, maintain, and optimize efficient scripts using Python and Golang to automate routine security and incident response tasks.
SOAR Platform Orchestration:  Develop and manage playbooks, workflows, and integrations within the Cortex XSOAR platform to accelerate incident resolution.
Cross-Functional Collaboration:  Partner closely with security analysts and cross-functional stakeholders to gather requirements and deliver impactful solutions.
Agile Sprint Participation:  Actively engage in daily stand-ups, sprint planning, and retrospectives to ensure continuous delivery within our Agile framework.
AI Implementation Support:  Assist in designing and implementing emerging AI technologies, including RAG architectures, to enhance security team capabilities.
Agent Communication Design:  Build and test reliable Agent-to-Agent communication workflows that support intelligent, automated decision-making processes.
MCP Integration Support:  Assist in the development, integration, and security of the Model Context Protocol (MCP) to standardize our AI interactions.
API Integration Management : Connect disparate internal systems and third-party security tools using robust RESTful API integrations.
Continuous Technology Learning:  Dedicate time to researching and experimenting with the latest advancements in AI and automation to identify new operational efficiencies.
Code Testing Review:  Conduct peer code reviews and implement automated testing to maintain a high-quality, secure, and reliable codebase.
Technical Documentation Creation:  Create and maintain comprehensive documentation for developed scripts, playbooks, and AI integrations to ensure team-wide knowledge sharing.
Required:
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a closely related field plus 5 years’ experience; Or Master’s Degree plus 4 years’ experience.
Respective years of related work experience in software engineering, automation, or integration development.
Strong proficiency in programming and scripting languages, specifically Python and Golang.
Proven experience developing and consuming RESTful APIs for complex system integrations.
Demonstrated capability and enthusiastic interest in learning new technologies, specifically in the AI space (e.g., LLMs, RAG, MCP).
Experience working effectively within an Agile/Scrum development methodology.
Excellent cross-functional collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to translate operational needs into technical solutions.
Solid understanding of software development lifecycles, version control (e.g., Git), and code testing principles.
Ability to work successfully in a hybrid work environment.
Preferred:
Hands-on experience with Cortex XSOAR or similar SOAR platforms (e.g., Splunk SOAR, Tines).
Prior exposure to or foundational knowledge of AI frameworks, RAG implementations, or Agent-to-Agent communications.
Basic understanding of cybersecurity principles or incident response workflows (prior security experience is not required, but an interest is a plus).
Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure-as-code deployments.
Experience with containerization technologies like Docker or Kubernetes.

title: Associate Director, Clinical Process Engineer
description:
About AbbVie
AbbVie's mission is to discover and deliver innovative medicines and solutions that solve serious health issues today and address the medical challenges of tomorrow. We strive to have a remarkable impact on people's lives across several key therapeutic areas including immunology, oncology and neuroscience - and products and services in our Allergan Aesthetics portfolio. For more information about AbbVie, please visit us at  www.abbvie.com . Follow @abbvie on  LinkedIn,   Facebook ,  Instagram ,  X  and  YouTube.
Purpose statement
Own and evolve the clinical process engineering capability within Clinical Development Operations, establishing the methodology, standards, and governance infrastructure that enable scalable, inspection-ready, and operationally excellent processes across the enterprise. The Associate Director, Clinical Process Engineer is the functional authority on process design and engineering practice, operating at the intersection of strategy, compliance, and execution. This role shapes how the discipline works, not just what it delivers, and is accountable for building the infrastructure and talent that sustains the capability long-term. Operates within a multilayered leadership structure and is expected to bring enterprise-level judgment and strong upward credibility.
Major responsibilities
Define and own the clinical process engineering methodology, standards, and toolset used across Clinical Development Operations; drive adoption and continuous evolution of the practice.
Serve as the enterprise subject matter authority on clinical process design, advising senior and executive leadership on process strategy, capability investments, and cross-functional process architecture.
Oversee the design and governance of end-to-end clinical processes across the enterprise; ensure coherence, scalability, and inspection readiness across domains and programs.
Lead enterprise-level current-state assessments and strategic process analyses; translate findings into capability recommendations and program-level improvement roadmaps for executive audiences.
Design and lead high-stakes, enterprise-wide process workshops and governance forums; manage executive-level stakeholder dynamics, resolve competing priorities, and drive strategic alignment.
Establish and own the process compliance, inspection readiness, and quality-by-design frameworks for the function; proactively manage risk and partner with quality and regulatory leadership on emerging expectations.
Lead and govern complex, cross-enterprise process-to-system programs; accountable for the quality and integrity of process design inputs feeding technology platforms and transformation initiatives.
Own the process performance measurement framework for the function; define enterprise KPIs, oversee reporting infrastructure, and present insights to senior leadership and governance bodies.
Set and govern documentation standards, decision record practices, and process governance infrastructure across Clinical Development Operations; responsible for audit readiness at a function-wide level.
May manage 0–5 direct reports; responsible for team leadership, talent strategy, performance management, and building a differentiated, high-impact process engineering capability.
Bachelor's degree in engineering, life sciences, business, or a related field required; advanced degree strongly preferred.

Position Summary
The Global HR Portfolio Lead is a critical role within AbbVie's People Strategy & Transformation team, responsible for creating and sustaining an enterprise-wide view of the work delivered by HR. The role will establish the global HR portfolio across three connected categories: annual strategic priorities, ongoing run-the-business programs and services, and locally managed programs and services across affiliates and regions.
Reporting to the leader of People Strategy & Transformation, this role connects people strategy to execution by building the portfolio, governance, technology, integrated roadmap, and decision forums required to improve prioritization and portfolio value. The portfolio will provide the CHRO and HR Leadership Team (HRLT) with a clear view of commitments, timing, dependencies, capacity, risks, and outcomes, enabling disciplined trade-offs across global and local work.
This role is for a pragmatic portfolio leader who can operate in ambiguity, create clarity across a complex global HR ecosystem, and translate strategy into simple, sustainable processes. Success will be defined not by producing project summaries, but by enabling higher-quality decisions, reducing activation friction, strengthening accountability, and increasing the impact of HR investments on employees and the business.
Key Responsibilities
Global HR Portfolio Strategy & Design
Create and maintain a comprehensive global HR portfolio that provides visibility into strategic initiatives, run-the-business programs and services, and local or regional HR programs and services.

The Principal Data Scientist is the senior technical and scientific leader for AbbVie's omnichannel engagement analytics, a data- and analytics-driven engagement optimization program spanning channel mix, content, field representative call planning, and orchestration. Operating within the APEX Enterprise Advanced Analytics and Innovation team, this role sets the multi-year science vision for personalized commercial engagement and is accountable for the technical strategy, methodology, and scientific rigor of the AI/ML and statistical solutions that power it. Reporting to the Associate Director, Data Science, the Principal is a thought partner to commercial and analytics leadership: shaping which problems are worth solving, forming and defending a point of view on how AI creates measurable business value, and partnering with product owners to turn that vision into scalable solutions. The role combines deep, hands-on expertise in applied machine learning, generative AI, causal inference, and experimentation with the consultative skill to align a complex stakeholder ecosystem around the right answer.
Key Responsibilities
Define the Data Science vision: Own the multi-year Data Science vision and technical roadmap for omnichannel engagement analytics, anticipating where both the business and the field of AI are heading.
Shape how AI creates business value: identify, size, and prioritize opportunities where AI can drive measurable commercial impact, build the business case, and influence senior leadership decisions on where to invest.
Lead hands-on with Gen-AI: Personally use AI-assisted development and agentic tools to prototype, test hypotheses, and demonstrate value quickly; build LLM-backed systems using advanced RAG and context engineering, paired with rigorous scientific evaluation frameworks to scale highly reliable omnichannel recommendations.
Lead the design of predictive and causal models: Develop next-best-action, recommendation, and sequential decision models that inform customer engagement and resource allocation using complex, multi-source data.
Own measurement science: set the standard for measuring effectiveness, incrementality, and business impact using experimental and quasi-experimental methods, so that AI investments are evaluated rigorously.
Partner with product owners to shape problems, not just fulfill requirements: co-define business outcomes, scope, and success metrics, and translate them into scalable technical solutions.
Navigate a complex stakeholder ecosystem: build alignment across brand and marketing leaders, field sales and operations, Medical, Legal and Regulatory (MLR), Compliance, BTS, Digital Lab, and external vendors; reframe requests into well-posed problems and resolve competing priorities.
Communicate with executive impact: translate complex methods and findings into clear recommendations and compelling narratives for executive and non-technical audiences.
Productionize at scale: Partner with BTS, Digital Lab, engineering, and platform teams to deploy, monitor, and manage the lifecycle of AI/ML solutions.
Raise the bar for scientific rigor: establish best practices in model development, code quality, reproducibility, peer review, and responsible AI across the data science community.
Be a thought leader: stay at the forefront of research and practice in machine learning, generative AI, and causal inference; bring new ideas into the team; provoke rigorous analytical debate; and represent AbbVie's point of view internally and in the broader analytics community.
Supervisory / Management Responsibilities
This role does not carry formal direct report responsibilities but is expected to act as a technical leader and mentor across the broader data science community, raising the bar on scientific rigor and hands-on AI practice. The Principal Data Scientist may lead technical workstreams with external analytics vendors and partners, including oversight of deliverable quality and methodology validation.

Scientific Engineering Depth: Deep expertise in machine learning, causal inference, and generative AI, combined with strong engineering discipline in reproducibility, deployment, and enterprise integration.
AI Fluency and Bias to Action: Uses AI hands-on in daily work to prototype, analyze, and build; critically evaluates AI output; and turns ideas into working solutions quickly.
Business Judgment and Problem-Framing: Translates ambiguous business challenges into well-scoped problems, connects technical choices to commercial value, and sets long-term technical direction while staying close to delivery.
Stakeholder Navigation and Executive Influence: Reads organizational dynamics to build alignment across commercial, regulatory, and technology partners, earning trust as a thought partner to win support from senior leaders.
Thought Leadership: Challenges conventional thinking and sparks meaningful analytical debate with peers and executives.
Education
Bachelor’s Degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering, or another quantitative discipline required; Master’s or PhD in a quantitative field strongly preferred.
Required Experience
8+ years of experience in data science, machine learning, or applied science (or 6+ years with a PhD), with a track record of delivering production-quality models that drove measurable business impact.
Demonstrated experience setting technical direction for a portfolio of AI/ML solutions and influencing decisions of senior business leaders.
Experience building personalization, recommendation, decision-optimization, or marketing-science solutions, in any industry.
Deep hands-on expertise in causal inference and experimentation, including A/B testing and quasi-experimental methods, to measure business impact.
Demonstrated hands-on experience using generative AI and AI-assisted development tools (e.g., LLM APIs, AI coding assistants, agent frameworks) to prototype and deliver solutions, with concrete examples that can be walked through during the interview process.
Expert proficiency in Python and SQL, with experience in deep learning frameworks (e.g., PyTorch, TensorFlow) and distributed data processing.
Experience productionizing AI/ML solutions in cloud environments, including deployment, monitoring, and lifecycle management.
Track record of leading initiatives across complex, cross-functional stakeholder environments and presenting to executive audiences.

Experience in omnichannel analytics, such as journey analysis, touchpoint measurement, closed-loop measurement, or next-best-action for HCP or patient engagement.

title: Scientist I, Biopharmaceutics
description:
About AbbVie
AbbVie's mission is to discover and deliver innovative medicines and solutions that solve serious health issues today and address the medical challenges of tomorrow. We strive to have a remarkable impact on people's lives across several key therapeutic areas including immunology, oncology and neuroscience - and products and services in our Allergan Aesthetics portfolio. For more information about AbbVie, please visit us at  www.abbvie.com . Follow @abbvie on  LinkedIn,   Facebook ,  Instagram ,  X  and  YouTube.
The Molecular Profiling and Drug Delivery (MPDD) function within the Small Molecule CMC organization is accountable for a broad range of deliverables across various stages of drug discovery and development. During lead optimization and through candidate selection, MPDD scientists utilize state-of-the-art automation and computational tools supported by expertise in biopharmaceutics, drug delivery, and solid-state chemistry to collaboratively progress candidates with higher probability of success into development and advise clinical formulation strategy. From candidate selection through clinical proof of concept and product launch, MPDD scientists work in cross functional teams to identify the commercial solid form of the active pharmaceutical ingredient (API) and establish structure-property-performance correlations to help deliver robust commercial processes and align control strategies across drug substance and product. They also transition drug substance isolation processes and relevant physical characterization methods to commercial manufacturing sites and work within teams to ensure successful regulatory submissions.
Biopharmaceutics and Drug Delivery scientists within AbbVie's MPDD organization work collaboratively with other functions within Development Sciences and Discovery to conduct developability assessment to select molecules with higher probability of success for clinical development and eventual commercialization. This includes profiling of physicochemical properties, development of preclinical formulations, identifying solutions to in vivo absorption challenges, and advancement of novel drug delivery strategies across multiple routes of administration that are aligned with program target product profiles and downstream partners.  Modalities of interest include traditional small molecules as well as complex chemically synthesized modalities such as protein degraders and peptides.  In this role, you will work in cross-functional teams in matrixed environments and engage in multidisciplinary problem solving.
Job Description
AbbVie's MPDD organization is seeking a highly motivated scientist with experience in biopharmaceutics for a Scientist I position. The primary role of this position is to design, execute, analyze, and interpret the studies that characterize the biopharmaceutical properties of drug candidates and enable developability and product performance related informed decision-making for emerging molecules on peptide and small molecule pipeline programs. The successful candidate will apply scientific knowledge and laboratory skills to support early- and late-stage development activities, communicate findings clearly, and collaborate effectively with multidisciplinary partners. The individual is expected to work effectively within multidisciplinary teams, demonstrate strong scientific rigor, and contribute to the advancement of project objectives through quality data generation, critical thinking, and clear communication.
Key Responsibilities
Design, execute, troubleshoot, and interpret experiments related to biopharmaceutics properties of small molecules and peptides such as solubility, dissolution, permeability, stability, aggregation, precipitation, and formulation performance, as applicable.
Generate high-quality data and maintain accurate, timely, and complete documentation of experimental procedures, results, and conclusions.
Analyze and summarize data using appropriate scientific methods and communicate findings to project teams and functional stakeholders.
Contribute to the assessment of candidate molecules and formulations by identifying key risks, opportunities, and data-driven recommendations.
Support development, optimization, and continuous improvement of experimental methods, workflows, and scientific capabilities.
Maintain awareness of external scientific advances and incorporate relevant knowledge into project work where appropriate.
Contribute to a collaborative, inclusive, and scientifically rigorous team environment.
Level and compensation will be commensurate with experience.
Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent education with typically 5 years of experience, or master’s degree or equivalent education with typically two years of experience in pharmaceutical or related industry.  Preferred educational backgrounds include but are not restricted to Pharmaceutical Sciences, Pharmaceutical Engineering, Chemical/ Biomedical Engineering, Chemistry, and Materials Science.
Fundamental understanding of biopharmaceutics in relation to drug absorption across routes of administration including solubility, biorelevant dissolution testing, permeability, ex vivo permeability assessment, and peptide aggregation.
Familiarity and preferred hands-on laboratory experience in in vitro assays and standard analytical techniques for physicochemical and biopharmaceutical property assessment to understand CMC developability profile. Techniques of interest include, but are not limited to chromatography, DSF, rat intestinal perfusion, Ussing Chambers, Franz Diffusion cells, dissolution, X-ray diffraction, thermal analysis, microscopy, biophysical characterization techniques, etc.
Knowledge of preclinical and clinical formulation development principles relevant to chemically synthesized molecules across routes of administration.
Ability to analyze data and draw scientifically sound conclusions.
Demonstrated strong communication skills and ability to clearly communicate theories and concepts, influence others without authority, and drive technical excellence.
Excellent self-management skills, organizational skills, and attention to detail.
Key Leadership Competencies
Builds strong relationship with peers and cross-functional partners to enable higher performance.
Learns fast, grasps the "essence”, and can change course quickly where indicated.
Connects ideas from disparate fields, integrates data and information quickly, and takes risks to achieve the highest performance.
Raises the bar and is never satisfied with the status quo. Demonstrates scientific curiosity and problem-solving ability.
Creates a learning environment, open to suggestions and experimentation for improvement.
Embraces the ideas of others, nurtures innovation and manages innovation to reality.

Position Summary
The role to lead the People Strategy & Transformation group is a critical leadership role within AbbVie's People Experience organization, serving as the primary architect of transformational change across the HR ecosystem. This leader is the strategic unlock to delivering on the broad, ambitious vision of the People Experience team — bringing together people strategy, HR planning and prioritization, technology strategy, experience story telling and communications, and portfolio management under a single, integrated leadership mandate.
This role is for an enterprise-scale strategist and systems thinker who understands how to connect vision to execution, drive structural and cultural change across a complex global organization, and leverage technology and storytelling to reimagine how HR delivers value. This role will lead a team of highly specialized functions and will serve as a driving force behind AbbVie's next generation of HR transformation.
Key Responsibilities
People Strategy
Define and champion an enterprise-wide people strategy that aligns with AbbVie's business priorities, workforce needs, and the long-term vision of the People Experience team.
Translate complex workforce trends, competitive intelligence, and organizational data into clear strategic direction for the PE organization, while supporting socialization with HR’s senior stakeholders.
Partner with the VP of People Experience and PE Leadership Team to set the multi-year strategic agenda and ensure coherent prioritization across functions.
Serve as a forward-looking thought leader, anticipating shifts in the external talent and HR landscape and positioning AbbVie to stay ahead.
People Branding & Storytelling
Lead AbbVie's People Branding strategy, shaping how the company's employee value proposition (EVP) and talent brand are articulated, activated, and experienced globally.
Build a compelling storytelling capability within the PE organization — translating the impact of People programs and initiatives into narratives that resonate with employees, candidates, leaders, and external stakeholders.
Partner with Corporate Communications, Marketing, and Business HR to ensure consistency and authenticity of AbbVie's people brand across all touchpoints.
Champion the PE team's own brand and visibility — elevating the strategic contribution of the People Experience function across the enterprise.
HR Strategy & Annual Prioritization
Own the HR strategy planning cycle, leading the annual prioritization process that aligns PE investments, resources, and initiatives to AbbVie's enterprise and business unit priorities.
Develop and maintain a clear, accessible view of the HR strategic agenda — ensuring all PE functions operate with shared context and coordinated direction.
Drive disciplined tradeoff decisions and resource allocation, ensuring the PE team is focused on highest-value work and prepared to adapt as business conditions evolve.
Establish and track strategic KPIs that measure progress toward the PE vision and demonstrate HR's impact on the business.
Planning & Budgeting
Lead the integrated planning and budgeting process for the People Experience organization, partnering with Finance and PE sub-function leaders to ensure responsible stewardship of resources.
Develop multi-year investment roadmaps that reflect the PE team's strategic priorities and build the organizational capabilities required to deliver on the vision.
Create visibility and accountability across PE budget performance, driving forecasting accuracy and identifying opportunities to reinvest resources toward highest-impact priorities.
Ensure planning cycles are connected to enterprise rhythms and informed by workforce and business data.
HR Technology Strategy
Provide executive leadership for AbbVie's HR Technology agenda, including the strategy and roadmap for core HR platforms (e.g., Workday) and emerging technologies.
Partner with IT and digital transformation leaders to evaluate and outline a plan to implement and scale HR technology solutions that simplify processes and improve employee experience
Champion the adoption of AI and automation across HR — identifying use cases, building each business case, and ensuring responsible and effective deployment of innovative tools.
Build an HR Technology rhythm that is agile and scalable to define a forward-focused roadmap
Chief of Staff & Integration
Oversee the Chief of Staff function for HR, ensuring these roles supporting HRLT in operating with strategic clarity, operational discipline, and integrated execution.
Ensure the integration of CoS roles helps drive alignment in the prlanning
HR Global Portfolio
Ensure the portfolio reflects strategic alignment to PE's vision and that delivery commitments are realistic, well-resourced, and actively managed.
Own the HR Global Portfolio — providing executive visibility into the full scope of HR initiatives, projects, and change efforts underway across the enterprise.
Provide senior HR leadership and executive stakeholders with clear, timely reporting on portfolio health, risks, and outcomes.
Required
Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Organizational Development, or a related field.
Progressive HR leadership experience, with significant scope across strategy, technology, and operational transformation.
Demonstrated success leading enterprise-scale HR strategy, planning, and/or HR technology programs in a large, complex, global organization.
Deep expertise in at least two of the following areas: HR strategy, HR technology, change management, PMO, or people branding.
Proven ability to translate vision into executable strategy and drive transformational change across matrixed, global organizations.
Strong executive presence with the ability to influence and align senior leaders, including C-suite stakeholders.
Experience building, developing, and inspiring high-performing, diverse teams across multiple functional disciplines.
Preferred
Advanced degree (MBA or Master's in HR, Organizational Psychology, or a related field).
Experience in the pharmaceutical, biotech, or life sciences industry.
Demonstrated experience leading HR technology transformations, including Workday implementations or AI-enabled HR platforms.
Prior experience in a Chief of Staff, Head of HR Strategy, or enterprise transformation leadership role.
Familiarity with global workforce planning, portfolio management methodologies (e.g., Agile, SAFe), and organizational design principles.
Competencies
Strategic Vision & Systems Thinking
Transformation & Change Leadership
HR Technology & Innovation Acumen
Executive Influence & Stakeholder Alignment
People Branding & Storytelling
Operational Excellence & Portfolio Governance
Why People Experience at AbbVie
The People Experience team is at the heart of how AbbVie attracts, develops, and retains the world-class talent needed to deliver on its mission. As Vice President, People Strategy & Transformation you will sit at the center of AbbVie's most consequential HR evolution — architecting the strategy, building the systems, and leading the people who turn the People Experience vision into reality. This is a rare opportunity to drive fundamental, lasting change at enterprise scale, shaping how AbbVie's people systems, technology, and culture evolve to meet the demands of the future.

Conceive and implement novel experimental approaches to address key scientific questions in immune cell depletion. Investigate, identify, and optimize new methods, assays, and techniques relevant to pathogenic cell target discovery, depletion therapeutic development, and immunological mechanisms of action. Contribute scientific insights to projects, particularly in areas such as inflammatory pathways, immune cell trafficking, immune receptor modulation, receptor targeting, target density in tissues, and receptor occupancy. Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including in vivo pharmacology, DMPK, and technology groups, to drive technical problem-solving and integrate efforts across projects. We are looking for a Senior Scientist I with a strong background in immunology, cell biology, and therapeutic discovery to join AbbVie’s Immunology Discovery organization. This lab-based position supports IND-enabling and early-stage discovery programs, as well as research and innovation in selective pathogenic cell depletion. The role involves hands-on experimentation using translational in vitro and ex vivo assays and PK/PD assessments, including autoimmune disease efficacy models, to evaluate depletion strategies and therapeutic candidates.
Responsibilities:
​​• Innovative Research & Method Development: Consistently demonstrate scientific initiative and creativity by exploring novel experimental approaches and developing new immunological methods to address complex research questions.
​• Autonomous Experimental Design & Troubleshooting: Operate with a high degree of autonomy in the lab, independently designing experiments and troubleshooting technical challenges with minimal supervision while maintaining rigorous scientific standards in support of pathogenic cell depletion programs.
​• Immunological Assays & Complex Cellular Systems: Design and execute a broad range of immunological assays, including ELISPOT, cytokine profiling, cellular potency assays, and whole blood assays, and use complex cellular systems to characterize immune responses, target engagement, depletion activity, selectivity, and recovery associated with therapeutic candidates.
​• PK/PD Relationships: Apply advanced analytical techniques, including multicolor flow cytometry for detailed cellular phenotyping and molecular assays such as digital PCR, qPCR, RNA extraction, and sequencing, to quantify biomarkers and gene expression changes and establish PK/PD relationships.
​• AI-Assisted Bioinformatics and Computational Target Discovery: Leverage AI-assisted bioinformatics and computational approaches to identify and prioritize disease-relevant targets for selective pathogenic cell depletion, integrating multi-omics and human disease data into experimentally testable hypotheses.
​• Data Analysis & Follow-Up Experiments: Analyze and interpret experimental data, draw meaningful conclusions, and proactively design follow-up experiments to test new hypotheses and guide subsequent project decisions.
​• Scientific Communication: Prepare clear and detailed technical reports and documentation of results, and effectively communicate findings through presentations and peer-reviewed publications, upholding AbbVie’s standards of scientific excellence.
​• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Actively participate in cross-functional team discussions and collaborative troubleshooting sessions with in vivo pharmacology, DMPK, and other internal teams, fostering a cooperative environment to overcome challenges and advance program goals.
​​
​​• Bachelor’s, Master’s, or PhD in Immunology or a related biological science, with typically 10+ years (BS), 8+ years (MS), or 0 years (PhD) of relevant experience
​• Strong theoretical and practical knowledge of immunology and related biological sciences, including cell biology and cell signaling. Experience in autoimmune disease biology, pathogenic immune cell populations, target validation, or immune cell depletion is preferred.
​• Technical Expertise (Immunological Assays): Hands-on experience with multi-color flow cytometry, cellular potency assays, cell depletion assays, and cytokine-based cellular assays.
​• Proven ability to design, execute, and troubleshoot complex experiments independently. Excellent organizational skills and meticulous documentation practices to ensure data accuracy and integrity.
​• Excellent scientific communication skills (written and oral) for effective report writing, data presentation, and team discussions.
​• Strong collaboration skills with the ability to contribute effectively in cross-functional team environments.
​• Demonstrated adaptability and curiosity, with a willingness to learn and apply new techniques and methodologies.
​Preferred/nice-to-have:
​• Technical Expertise in Live Cell Imaging (Incucyte, xCELLigence) and Molecular Biology (digital PCR (ddPCR) and quantitative PCR (qPCR), as well as RNA isolation)
​• Bioinformatics and computational biology: Experience applying bioinformatics and computational biology approaches to analyze high-dimensional immunology datasets, including single-cell RNA sequencing, bulk transcriptomics, immune-receptor repertoire data, or multi-omics, and translating results into testable biological hypotheses and drug discovery decisions.

title: Lead Business Process Improvement
description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.
The Community You Will Join:
The Business Process Improvement team focuses on improving processes across all Community Support. Our team is a global team of process improvement professionals, who help bring cross functional partners from across CS and Airbnb together to operationalize new processes, analyze current process for improvement opportunities, and scale solutions across a global network. We follow general business process engineering principles and practices, as well as leveraging Lean Six Sigma methodologies in our improvement projects.
The Difference You Will Make:
As a Business Process Improvement (BPI) Lead you are responsible for driving large-scale, cross-functional improvement projects that help to improve customer support for our community.
You will deliver new process designs and process improvements for key priority Community Support (CS) Roadmap programs, where you will take on responsibilities for process analysis, process design, pilot design and execution, and control plan development to improve the user experience.
You will work cross-functionally with other Shared Services functions, Policy, and Product  teams to lead the process impact assessment and subsequent process design for high priority changes. You will drive continuous improvement with these cross functional partners to increase overall operational efficiency, customer experience, and process quality.
You will use and improve AI tools in order to design and implement process measurement systems, analyze process data and utilize this information to drive decision making, successful improvement projects to completion, and propose Continuous Improvement projects. You will create queries and utilize data analytics tools to support process improvement efforts. You will validate analytics with your data partners.
You will be responsible for the delivery of successful improvement projects with measurable positive impact and also transition these solutions to operations for sustained results including feature launches throughout the year.
A Typical Day:
Leads large cross-functional process engineering initiatives from problem definition through measurable outcomes, applying the full suite of Lean Six Sigma tools and a structured process engineering framework across four disciplines: understanding the problem and its system context, designing reliable and measurable solutions, grounding those solutions in operational reality, and evolving them as conditions change.
Apply systems thinking: mapping full upstream and downstream context before prescribing solutions, identifying where the real problem lives rather than where it surfaces.
Design processes for AI-readiness and automation, including designing around three standards: reduce agent and customer burden, measurable from day one, and ability to be automated or self-correcting over time.
Build some AI prototypes to communicate and validate process designs, using AI tools, workflow automation platforms, and lightweight modeling approaches to test the viability of new process architectures before committing to full implementation.
Use some basic process simulation to model how a designed process will behave under real-world conditions, stress-testing assumptions about volume, variation, and failure modes before a design is deployed.
Continuously improve process designs of Community Support experiences that document the full interaction across the customer journey, agent processes, product features, and policies, informing multi-year roadmap planning.
Implement process measurement systems from the start of every design: establish KPIs, deploy statistical process control methods, and track outcomes post-launch to confirm improvements hold.
Lead change management for process transitions, ensuring new designs are adopted effectively by agents, teams, and partners and that improvements are sustained over time.
Partner with Product and Technology teams to translate process requirements into tooling specifications, ensuring AI and other product capabilities are engineered around how agents and customers actually work.
Collaborate cross-functionally with stakeholders across Product, Engineering, Data Analytics, and Operations to align priorities and drive trade-off decisions grounded in data.
Communicate progress and findings to leadership, distilling complex analysis into clear narratives with a line of sight to measurable outcomes
Organizes their work, keeps project stakeholders updated, and is able to work autonomously to drive progress across stakeholders.
Your Expertise:
Preferred Bachelor's Degree in Industrial Engineering, Engineering, or a related field.
5+ years of post-graduate experience in operations (industrial engineering or similar preferred experience)
Advanced knowledge of customer service and contact center operations
Lean Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt certified or equivalent process engineering expertise. Additional consideration given to Agile, service design, and Industrial and Systems Engineering experience.
Demonstrated ability to use AI to improve quality and efficiency within internal workflows.
Demonstrated ability to design processes for AI-readiness and automation.
Proven experience applying systems thinking to process design, identifying root causes upstream and tracing impacts downstream before prescribing solutions.
Ability to navigate ambiguity with creative problem-solving, strong analytical skills, and a pragmatic sense of how to get things done.
Ability to manage multiple initiatives simultaneously with minimal direction.
Strong statistical and data-driven analytical skills, including statistical process control methods, regression analysis, and measurement system analysis.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Ability to travel up to 20% of time

• Own the definition and prioritization of new in-store restaurant concepts and menu platforms, grounded in consumer insight, food trends, and the competitive fast casual landscape.
• Set the strategic framework (positioning, priorities, success criteria) that guides culinary development, and partner with WFM Culinary Development, who own item-level creation.
• Build test, pilot, and scaling plans for new concepts and menu platforms, with clear readiness gates before broader rollout.
• Drive execution of program deliverables across internal stakeholder teams and external supplier partners.
• Manage the multi-year concept and menu-strategy pipeline, identifying white space and platform-level opportunities.
• Establish metrics to monitor concept and menu performance and recommend improvements to quality, guest satisfaction, and profitability.
• Prepare executive-ready deliverables and manage alignment and communication with key stakeholders.
• Earn trust and build partnerships with senior leaders across the organization and with external partners.
• Operate as a change agent, with resilience, emotional intelligence, and the ability to navigate ambiguity.
Travel Requirements: Approximately 25% travel may be required.
• Proven track record developing menu strategy and driving execution to deliver business results.
• Understanding of how restaurant menu strategy works: consumer insight, menu architecture and positioning, food cost and margin, and menu-platform lifecycle.
• Strong quantitative background; connects consumer and menu analytics to financial outcomes.
• Ability to think beyond the P&L to arrive at true value and drive impactful decisions.
• Strong oral, written, and formal presentation skills, including Amazon-style business writing.
• Experience operating in a large, complex retail or multi-unit restaurant organization.
• Strategic mindset with strong critical thinking and the ability to craft compelling business cases.

A typical day for the Program Manager on this team blends strategic thinking with hands-on cross-functional collaboration. Our culture rewards curiosity, deep ownership, and creative problem-solving. If you’re passionate about food and want your work to directly shape what customers eat every day, this is the team for you.

title: Senior Technical Program Manager, Ads AI Core Infrastructure
description:
Amazon Advertising is investing heavily in building AI-native data infrastructure, and our team sits at the center of that transformation. We own the Ads Real-Time Data Service and Advertiser Profiles: the systems that provide every advertising AI agent with immediate, structured access to advertiser context. Today, advertising agents and skills across Amazon depend on our platform to answer questions about campaign performance, budget allocation, brand positioning, and advertiser behavior within sub-second latency. We process billions of data points daily with 1-3 minute refresh cadences, serving millions of advertisers across all Amazon marketplaces worldwide.
Our team is part of Ads AI Core Infrastructure (ACI), the organization responsible for the foundational systems that make Amazon's advertising AI possible: knowledge bases, runtime environments, agent tooling, and the real-time data layer that connects them all. The programs you will lead span the full lifecycle: from defining the data model and onboarding new advertiser signal types, to coordinating cross-organization launches with agent teams, measurement systems, and advertising console experiences. You will own programs that touch 30+ engineering teams across 10 VP organizations, drive alignment between science teams developing new embedding and retrieval techniques and engineering teams productionizing them, and manage the rollout of platform capabilities to advertising agents and skills across Amazon's global advertising business. The work is technically complex (distributed systems, real-time streaming, large language model optimization), organizationally complex (multiple VP-level stakeholders with competing priorities), and time-sensitive (agent teams are shipping new advertiser experiences weekly and depend on our platform to keep pace).
Key job responsibilities
Program Strategy & Roadmap Ownership
You own the multi-quarter roadmap for Advertiser Data and Profiles across both our team and our partner teams. You define program milestones, success metrics, and delivery timelines. You write and present the program narrative for OP1/OP2 documents and monthly business reviews to Directors and VPs. You make data-driven trade-off recommendations when scope, resources, and timelines conflict, and you drive crisp decisions about what ships now versus what defers.
Cross-Organization Program Delivery
You manage programs spanning our platform engineering team, applied science teams building embedding and retrieval models, agent builder teams consuming our APIs, measurement and attribution teams depending on our data, and advertising console teams surfacing profile data to advertisers directly. You create and maintain program schedules that account for cross-team dependencies, negotiate resource commitments, and drive weekly execution cadence across all workstreams. When programs stall, you diagnose whether the block is technical, organizational, or resource-based, and you drive resolution through the appropriate path.
Technical Program Leadership
You understand distributed systems architecture well enough to participate in design reviews, challenge assumptions about data freshness and consistency guarantees, and ensure that what we commit to delivering is technically feasible within the stated timeline. You work with engineers to decompose large programs into independently deliverable milestones. You ensure that real-time ingestion pipelines, MCP server infrastructure, and profile computation systems meet their availability and latency commitments. You own the launch readiness process for platform features consumed by 30+ downstream teams.
Operational Excellence & Risk Management
You establish and maintain the mechanisms that keep programs healthy: status dashboards, weekly program reviews, escalation criteria, and stakeholder communication cadences. You proactively identify risks weeks before they become blockers and bring mitigation plans. You run retrospectives after major launches and drive the resulting improvements into team process. You own capacity planning coordination across our services during peak advertising seasons.
Stakeholder Communication & Influence
You are the single-threaded owner of program communication to senior leadership. You write documents that clearly articulate scope, timeline, risk, and trade-offs for Directors and VPs. You present at monthly business reviews and operational reviews. You build consensus across teams with different priorities by finding the framing that connects each team's goals to the program outcome. You manage expectations proactively, ensuring leadership is never surprised by delays or scope changes.
A day in the life
Morning: Program Execution and Unblocking
Your day starts with the program dashboard showing 3 of 4 workstreams green and one yellow: the real-time campaign ingestion pipeline is blocked on a schema change from the upstream data warehouse team. You write a concise status update to your Director with the issue, impact to timeline, and your proposed mitigation. You then join a 30-minute stand-up with your cross-team leads where you confirm the data warehouse team has scheduled the schema migration for next sprint. You update the program tracker, adjust the downstream timeline by 3 days, and notify the agent teams that their new campaign signals onboarding date shifted.
Mid-morning, you are in a design review with the platform engineers and an Applied Scientist. They are proposing a new context compression approach for high-cardinality advertiser data that would reduce token consumption by 35% but requires changes to the MCP server response format. You ask questions about backward compatibility, migration path for existing consumers, and latency impact. You determine this needs a phased rollout and work with the team to define the phases and success criteria for each.
Afternoon: Strategic Planning and Stakeholder Alignment
After lunch, you are drafting the Q4 roadmap section for the OP1 narrative. You are framing the Advertiser Profiles expansion in terms of what it enables for advertisers (richer recommendations, faster onboarding to new ad products) rather than the technical components. You coordinate with the product manager on the customer-facing narrative and with the science lead on which profile signals will be ready by launch.
You join a weekly sync with the three agent teams that are your largest consumers. They want real-time access to advertiser creative assets as part of the profile. You assess the engineering cost, negotiate a phased delivery (metadata first, full assets in Q1), and commit to a date for the first phase. You document the agreement and add the work items to the backlog.
Late Afternoon: Operational Reviews and Forward Planning
You run a 45-minute program review with your Director and the partner team leads. You walk through each workstream: what shipped this week, what ships next week, where the risks are. One risk surfaces: the data warehouse team is planning a schema migration that could disrupt our ingestion pipelines during peak season. You escalate this to your VP with a clear ask (timing coordination) and a proposed resolution path.
Before end of day, you review the launch readiness checklist for next week's release of a new profile data type to all advertising agents. Load testing passed, documentation is complete, the rollback plan is reviewed. You approve the launch and send the go/no-go communication to stakeholders.

Job Description:
About Crowe AI
Everything we do is about making the future of human work more purposeful. We do this by leveraging state-of-the-art machine learning, generative AI, modern architectures, and industry experts to create AI-powered solutions that transform the way we do business.
Our world-class AI and ML professionals give Crowe the ability to capture and harness the power of data. A combination of AI and Machine Learning Engineers and AI Platform and Infrastructure Engineers create and deploy AI functionality to solve complex problems. We focus on building scalable AI solutions, based on rigorous data exploration, validation via proof-of-concept buildout, and close partnership with subject matter experts across business areas.
The future is powered by AI, come build it with us.
Role Overview
Crowe’s Studio team is seeking an AI Tech Lead to serve as a hands-on technical leader for the design, development, and lifecycle management of AI agents that accelerate the delivery of Crowe’s Audit services. This role is built around Crowe’s forward deployed engineer (FDE) model: rather than sitting above a project as a traditional program manager, this person sits with Audit practitioners, learns the workflow, designs the agent as it is built, and owns the outcome end to end. The goal is to establish the technical patterns, Skills-based architecture, and engineering practices needed to support a growing portfolio of agents. As that portfolio grows, the role is expected to grow into leading a small team as an engineering manager with full-stack engineers who each own a slice of the roadmap.
Key Responsibilities
Delivery of Audit AI Agents
Own the design, development, maintenance, and continuous improvement of AI agents and agent-assisted workflows that accelerate the execution of common tasks across Crowe’s Audit practice.
Operate as a forward deployed engineer paired directly with an Audit SME — sitting with practitioners, learning the workflow firsthand, and designing the agent as it is built rather than from a static spec.
Remain hands-on in development: write, review, test, and maintain substantial Python codebases and the Skills, instructions, prompts, and supporting resources that define agent behavior.
Manage project scope, timelines, and stakeholder communication for the agents you own — balancing hands-on delivery with the planning, prioritization, and coordination expected of a senior technical lead.
Design and develop agents using a Skills-based architecture — modular, reusable capabilities that can be efficiently discovered, invoked, tested, maintained, and enhanced over time.
Serve as the technical authority for the agent layer, making key design and implementation decisions while partnering with architects and engineering teams to ensure alignment with the broader Audit technology ecosystem.
Implement and maintain monitoring, observability, and alerting for agents running in production, including trace-level visibility into agent reasoning and tool calls, to proactively detect, diagnose, and resolve issues.
Build and Scale the Engineering Capability
Establish reusable engineering patterns and development practices that let a growing portfolio of agents be developed, evaluated, deployed, supported, and enhanced sustainably.
Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines in Azure DevOps to automate testing, evaluation, and deployment of agents across environments.
As the portfolio grows, lead a small team of forward deployed engineers that advance the roadmap per the audit stakeholders they serve.
Participate in the development and evolution of agent evaluation strategies, including representative test cases, automated evaluators, regression testing, quantifiable accuracy metrics, and processes for identifying and addressing changes in agent behavior.
Mentor engineers and provide technical leadership, including code and design reviews, as the agent portfolio and supporting team grow.
Promote collaboration across the Audit BU and the broader Studio to surface opportunities, share reusable patterns, and avoid duplicated build effort.
Product Judgment
Think in terms of ROI, business case, and value pool for every initiative, defining and tracking KPIs to measure and communicate business impact; make product decisions directly alongside the SME rather than routing through a separate product owner.
Demonstrate a solutions-oriented approach: be proactive, identify solutions independently, initiate activities, and follow through to completion.
Leverage data and insights to shape and defend a point of view aligned to Audit’s business needs.
Communicate proficiently with both technical staff and business leaders, articulating complex ideas, strategies, and recommendations in terms each audience can act on.
Required Qualifications
8+ years of professional software engineering experience developing, implementing, and supporting enterprise applications and services.
5+ years of professional Python development experience, with a strong track record of building enterprise-grade applications and services.
Demonstrated ability to write clean, maintainable, modular, testable, and well-structured Python code designed for long-term support and scalability — production-grade software that does not create technical debt.
1+ years of hands-on experience designing, developing, and productionizing AI agents or AI-assisted workflows using a major AI platform or model provider such as Microsoft, Anthropic, or OpenAI.
Hands-on experience developing agents using a Skills-based architecture, including authoring and maintaining Skills definitions, markdown-based instructions, supporting resources, and executable code used by agents.
Experience testing and evaluating AI systems, including automated evaluators, representative test cases, regression testing, and analysis of agent failure modes.
Demonstrated ability to embrace and advocate for AI-assisted software engineering practices, including the effective use of coding assistants (e.g. Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot), automated testing, and design-time AI tools to accelerate solution design, improve quality, and enhance developer productivity.
Demonstrated project management experience — scoping, planning, and managing technical projects/initiatives end-to-end in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment — with a strong track record of proactive, independent problem-solving.
Experience providing technical leadership to software engineering teams, including mentoring engineers, conducting code and design reviews, and establishing engineering practices and standards.
Experience designing and deploying AI/ML solutions on major cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, and/or GCP), including the use of managed AI services, cloud-native integration patterns, scalable data architectures, and secure, enterprise-grade deployments. Azure experience preferred
Experience with Azure DevOps — including building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines — or a similar platform, and Git-based version control.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical work to non-technical business leaders and translate complex requirements into practical technical solutions alongside product managers, architects, and business stakeholders.
Preferred Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
Experience developing software or AI solutions for Audit, accounting, public accounting, financial services, or another regulated industry.
Proficiency with modern AI/ML frameworks, tools, and agent platforms (e.g. MCP, A2A, Microsoft Foundry, OpenAI Agent SDK, Microsoft Agent Framework, Claude SDK, LangGraph, LangChain, LlamaIndex, Microsoft Copilot Studio, or equivalent). Knowledge of retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), vector databases, embeddings, and techniques for grounding model outputs in enterprise data.
Experience delivering solutions with the Microsoft .NET stack, C#, and SQL Server.
Experience helping establish or scale an engineering capability, including defining development standards, reusable patterns, and practices that support a growing team and portfolio of production solutions.
Consulting, product management, investment banking, or startup experience that has developed strong commercial and product instincts.
Prior experience as a forward deployed engineer or similar embedded technical role, partnering directly with subject matter experts to design and build workflow software without a separate product-owner layer.
Demonstrated passion for sharing what you learn, whether by offering cross-training opportunities, giving internal team “lightning talks,” or by writing detailed comments on tickets when you close them.
Demonstrated curiosity and continuous learning mindset in Generative AI and applied machine learning, with an interest in staying current on emerging models, architectures, and techniques, including engaging with original research, technical papers, and pre-release concepts before they are broadly commercialized

They handle everything from setting up essential account information like bank routing to helping merchants update and expand their inventory and ensure their POS integration system is operating effectively.. Additionally, they actively participate in quarterly business reviews to measure and enhance Managed Merchant revenue, ensuring continuous comprehensive support and improvement.
At DoorDash, we believe in fostering a culture of meaningful connection, collaboration, and professional growth through in-office interactions. This position requires an in-office presence at the DoorDash corporate office in Tempe and the employee must live within a commutable 50 miles from the office. Pilot different experiences from time to time to learn how we can invest in our highest value Managed Merchants

Develop expertise in how DoorDash's systems and resources work and how to use them to promote positive outcomes for our Managed Merchants

Experience providing advisory and partnership-level support through both proactive and reactive interactions with end users
You are proficient with Salesforce (or other CRM software), and have the ability to view and interpret dashboards/data.
Proficient with G Suite - including GSheets/Excel
Experience with SQL/Mode is a plus
Experience in a metric-driven support environment

About the Team
DashMart is a local-fulfillment center owned and operated by DoorDash, offering customers household essentials and other items to their doorsteps with speed, reliability, and quality. Customers order their convenience, grocery, retail, and prepared foods in the DoorDash app, and our team members fulfill orders in a real, brick-and-mortar store for Dashers to deliver. We’re open early and close late - some sites even run 24/7!
About the Role
DashMart is looking for a motivated and experienced individual that excels in fast-paced, physical environments and is excited to roll up their sleeves and actively engage in day-to-day operations.  In this role, you will work within a local fulfillment center supporting Site Management running great shifts, and delegating tasks. As a Shift Lead, you will have shift responsibility for fulfilling orders in a warehouse environment and maintaining inventory, and in some locations, this involves preparing food in a light-prep kitchen.
You’re excited about this opportunity because you will…
Be an Owner: Take ownership of your assigned shifts, including warehouse and kitchen processes, safety/cleanliness, quality, and training. Maintain accountability for inventory, equipment, and other company assets to ensure they are properly handled, stored, and protected from loss or theft.
Delight Customers: Ensure customer orders are delivered with high quality by executing orders accurately, communicating with customers when issues arise, and making sure Dasher pickups go smoothly.
Lead: Guide Operations Associates through their shift by ensuring the team works safely and productively and serving as the point of escalation for daily operations.
One Team One Fight: Support operations in both the warehouse and kitchen, assist with day-to-day tasks, and lead by example. You will be expected to engage in professional and respectful interactions with team members and customers, ensuring a positive and safe atmosphere in the warehouse while providing a high-quality experience for our customers.

We’re excited about you because…

You have a high school diploma or GED equivalent. A college diploma is even better but not required.

title: Senior Account Executive - Key Accounts
description:
About MISUMI Americas
MISUMI Americas, a division of MISUMI Group, is a leading provider of standard, configurable, and custom manufacturing solutions. By integrating a vast catalog of components with a world-class digital manufacturing platform, MISUMI Americas empowers engineers and procurement teams to accelerate innovation across the entire product lifecycle. With operations in the San Francisco Bay Area and Chicago, the company serves as a vital partner for the most innovative companies in the Americas.
Impact In This Role
As a Senior Account Executive on the MedTech, Aerospace, Robotics, Energy and Mobility Key Accounts Sales Team, you will work with some of the most innovative companies in the world to help them bring ambitious products to market. You will develop and expand accounts with multi-million-dollar manufacturing potential in a complex, consultative sales motion — earning credibility with engineering, supply chain, procurement, operations, and executive stakeholders while helping customers solve urgent manufacturing challenges, all while balancing high-velocity transactional demand within your accounts.
This role operates at the intersection of enterprise strategy, technical manufacturing, and commercial execution. The bar is high because the opportunity is high: MISUMI Americas' key accounts require someone who can earn trust with sophisticated customers, navigate ambiguity, and build large partnerships out of complex technical problems. A top performer will not simply sell capacity — they will build deep relationships inside large organizations, identify where MISUMI Americas can materially improve speed, quality, cost, flexibility, or supply-chain resilience, and convert those opportunities into durable partnerships.
What You’ll Be Doing
Develop and execute strategic account plans for large enterprise targets. Own a defined portfolio of high-potential accounts and build strategies that map business units, engineering teams, procurement groups, manufacturing decision-makers, executive sponsors, incumbent supplier relationships, program timelines, and expansion paths. Top performers know where the account is going before the customer issues an RFQ.
Create and progress complex, multi-stakeholder opportunities. Identify manufacturing pain across prototype, NPI, low-volume production, bridge production, and supply-chain resiliency use cases. Navigate long cycles involving engineering validation, supplier qualification, procurement scrutiny, legal review, quality requirements, and executive approval.
Translate technical manufacturing challenges into business value. Understand requirements across CNC machining, injection molding, sheet metal fabrication, additive manufacturing, tolerances, materials, inspection, DFM, lead times, cost drivers, and production risk — and convert them into commercial value tied to speed-to-market, engineering throughput, supply continuity, working-capital efficiency, and total cost of ownership.
Lead cross-functional deal orchestration. Partner with applications engineering, sourcing, manufacturing operations, customer success, quality, finance, and leadership to design solutions that can be sold, delivered, scaled, and renewed — coordinating internal resources with discipline and urgency rather than throwing opportunities over the wall.
Build executive-level relationships and expansion pathways. Establish credibility beyond the initial buying group with VP- and C-level leaders in engineering, supply chain, operations, product development, and procurement. Use early wins to expand across divisions, product lines, geographies, and manufacturing categories.
Own commercial strategy, negotiation, and closing. Drive pricing strategy, business cases, proposals, MSAs, supplier onboarding, enterprise agreements, and complex negotiations — balancing customer advocacy with MISUMI Americas' commercial goals so deals are strategically valuable, operationally executable, and positioned for long-term growth.
Maintain rigorous pipeline discipline and forecast accuracy. Build a sufficient, qualified pipeline, manage opportunity stages with precision, surface risk early, and maintain a reliable forecast. Excellence requires both strategic creativity and operating discipline.
Desired Traits
Required
8+ years of B2B sales experience, including 5+ years selling complex technical solutions into enterprise or strategic accounts.
Demonstrated success closing and expanding six- and seven-figure ACV opportunities, with direct involvement in multi-million-dollar account growth.
Consistent record of meeting or exceeding quota in a long-cycle, consultative sales environment.
Experience selling into organizations where buying decisions span engineering, procurement, supply chain, operations, finance, legal, and executive stakeholders.
Working knowledge of technical manufacturing, engineering services, industrial supply chains, or product development, with the ability to discuss tolerances, materials, processes, lead times, quality standards, DFM, inspection, and supplier qualification.
Strong command of enterprise sales methodology, account planning, pipeline management, deal qualification, mutual action plans, and executive-level selling.
Comfortable owning a territory or named-account book with high expectations for pipeline creation, deal strategy, forecast integrity, and expansion.
Able to spend 50%+ of time out of the office, in front of customers.
Preferred
Familiarity with CNC machining, injection molding, sheet metal, urethane casting, additive manufacturing, or precision manufacturing workflows.
Prior success selling into aerospace, medical device, robotics, mobility, automotive, consumer electronics, industrial equipment, or energy sectors.
Experience displacing incumbent suppliers or introducing a new operating model into conservative manufacturing organizations.
Background using MEDDICC, Challenger, Command of the Message, Force Management, or similar enterprise sales frameworks.
Experience managing accounts with both centralized procurement and decentralized engineering demand.
BS in Engineering or a technical degree.
Physical Demands
Primarily remote/home-office work with extended periods at a computer. The role requires frequent domestic travel to customer sites, manufacturing facilities, trade shows, and team offsites, including standing, walking plant floors, and occasional lifting of sample parts or demo materials.

Competitive medical, dental, and vision insurance
401K plan
Paid volunteer days

title: Integration Support Engineer
description:
About Flexport:
At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That’s why it’s our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. We’re shaping the future of a $10T industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. Today, companies of all sizes—from emerging brands to Fortune 500s—use Flexport technology to move more than $19B of merchandise across 112 countries a year.
The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us.
Build the solutions to help Flexport grow
The Ecosystem team’s mission is to make information exchange in global trade easy for everyone by efficiently, securely and reliably connecting the Flexport Platform with the external Global Trade Ecosystem.
The opportunity
We are looking for a talented Integration Support Engineer to join our team! In this role you will be supporting the integrations built to help exchange data between Flexport and our customers and partners.. You will serve as an SME for customers utilizing our self-service API’s, providing technical team members with business knowledge to help us solve our customers API issues..
Integrating our best in class platform seamlessly with our logistics partners is a critical component of our strategy. Our integrated solutions bring end to end automation in the information exchange that is required between us and our partners, eliminating slow and error prone manual workflows. This requires the Flexport platform to be fully integrated with customers and any third party systems our customer uses. The success of our team is measured by the extent to which information exchange between Flexport and our customers is reliably and effectively automated, reducing cost to serve for our operations teams.
We’re looking for an organized and motivated person to ensure inbound requests are triaged quickly and efficiently, owning all communications with major stakeholders including customers, engineers and platform teams. In addition, you’ll work closely with Solutions Engineers and Solutions Consultants to identify process improvements that will maximize the efficiency of the integration support team.
You will serve as a technical anchor for our production environment. You will go beyond basic triage to lead deep-dive technical investigations, implement code or configuration enhancements, and collaborate cross-functionally to improve the scalability of our ecosystem. title: Product Manager - Valves
description:
Fortune Brands Innovations (NYSE: FBIN) is an industry-leading home, security and digital products company with a portfolio of trusted brands, including Moen, House of Rohl, Therma-Tru, Larson, Master Lock, Yale residential, and Sentry Safe.
We are building a company that is determined to win, and we are clear about how: strong brands, great people, and disciplined execution.
